# Viridis Run 026 input fixtures

These four Lean modules are unchanged copies of the modules used in the local
Run 026 product trial (September 6, 2026). They exercise 19 mathematical declarations
associated with Justin Hart's _The Speed Limit Shadow Price Tower_ paper.

The tests read declaration signatures; they never execute Lean or the proof bodies.
These copies are input fixtures, not new certification, a complete formalization of
the paper, or evidence for its physical interpretations. The separate recorded
extraction is compared with these previews in the local evaluation receipt.
